I searched the whole tree with find: no file of that name exists anywhere, and this line is its only mention in .md, .ts or .py. The .ts carries no computation or witness field either, so nothing backs the per-isotope claim. (I can say what is here now; this clone is shallow and I make no claim about what was here before.) (2) THE CLOSING CLAIM IS UNDERCUT BY THE BLOCK'S OWN TABLE. "The unified path uses one symbolic algorithm with zero fitted parameters and no special-case branches" is immediately followed by "The discrepancy between the two paths quantifies the residual that the LP-dual accumulator does not absorb" - the discrepancy being a deuteron at -16.45 MeV against an experimental +2.224 and Pb-208 at +58%. Zero fitted parameters is a real and creditable property; describing an unbound deuteron as a quantified residual is not.
